title: Playboy Magazine April 1974 Marlene Morrow Jane Fonda Tom Hayden
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, April 1974 issue, Playmate Marlene Morrow. Featured: Jane Fonda and Tom Hayden interviewed, "Fourplay" with Zero Mostel and Pat Paulsen, and "Life and Death in Israel and Egypt."
Complete issue, no missing pages. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
